title: Elixir and Phoenix Backend Foundations
description: Practice building a Phoenix API, modeling relational data, writing SQL queries, caching with Redis and exposing a GraphQL endpoint.

lessons.title: Model a backend request
lessons.body:
A Phoenix request passes through a router and a controller before a context performs the business operation. Keep database queries in the context so both HTTP and background work use the same rules. PostgreSQL stores durable records; Redis can cache results that can be reconstructed. A cache must not be the only copy of important data. GraphQL resolvers should call the same authorized context functions as REST controllers.

Learning goals
After this lesson, explain the main idea in your own words and identify how it relates to these job skills: Elixir, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, Redis, SQL, GraphQL.

lessons.title: Guided practice
lessons.body:

lessons.title: Separate service responsibilities
lessons.body:
A Spring controller handles HTTP input, a service coordinates a business operation, and a repository reads or writes persisted records. Constructor injection makes dependencies explicit. Validate request data before saving it. A transaction groups related database changes so that either all of them commit or none of them do. Parameterized SQL separates values from query syntax.

title: Team Leadership and Shift Planning
description: Practice shift handovers, team feedback, workload planning and inventory coordination using a small operations-team scenario.

lessons.title: Make responsibilities and handovers explicit
lessons.body:
Team leadership combines clear expectations, realistic planning and feedback. A handover should explain current work, unresolved issues and the next responsible person. Use specific observations when giving feedback and invite the other person's perspective. Inventory decisions affect both the team and service, so communicate shortages early. A plan should include how the team escalates an unexpected problem, not just the ideal schedule.

Learning goals
After this lesson, explain the main idea in your own words and identify how it relates to these job skills: Team Leadership, Communication, Teamwork, Inventory Planning.

lessons.title: Guided practice
lessons.body:
Plan a shift for a four-person team. Assign responsibilities, prepare a handover note and add an unexpected stock shortage. Write a short feedback conversation using an observable example. Explain who owns the next action, when it will be checked and how the team can raise a concern.
